title: Banks Act Circular C2/2018 — Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Requirements related to a due diligence audit of the financial condition of a bank. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
